name: Content Explorer
description: Browse and manage assets by type. Composes ContentTypeManagerCell and ContentManagerCell to provide a unified asset browsing experience with type selection, asset listing, and management actions.

category.description: Cell category - 'ephemeral' marks this as ephemeral utility (not persisted)

selected_type_id.description: Currently selected content type ID for filtering assets

_discovery.describe: Visual content browser for exploring typed assets across the project. Provides grid/list views with filtering, sorting, and preview capabilities. Supports thumbnails for images, metadata previews for 3D models, and quick actions (open, download, delete). Integrates with ContentType system for type-aware rendering. Fast browsing experience (~1-2 seconds for queries). Useful for discovering existing content before creating new assets.
use_cases: Find content by type or tags
Preview content before using in cells
